filters.description: Spectrum list filters，每行一条；默认含质心化 filter

numpress_linear.description: Enable numpress linear prediction compression for m/z and RT

database_path.description: Path to target+decoy FASTA (toolkit database --custom output)

ram_gb.description: JVM heap size (-Xmx) in GB. Default 16: full-proteome DBs (human-uniprot) + variable PTM mods (acetyl/ubiq/glyco) build multi-million-peptide indexes that OOM an 8 GB heap.

precursor_tolerance_ppm.description: Precursor mass window (±ppm) for closed search

precursor_mass_lower_da.description: Open-search asymmetric lower bound (Da). When set with _upper_da, overrides ppm window.

precursor_mass_upper_da.description: Open-search asymmetric upper bound (Da). When set with _lower_da, overrides ppm window.

isotope_error.description: Allowed precursor monoisotopic peak offsets, slash-separated

mass_diff_to_variable_mod.description: Delta mass → variable mod. 0=no; 1=yes+remove; 2=yes+keep. Open/mass-offset searches need 1.

localize_delta_mass.description: Mass-shifted fragment ion localization. 0=off, 1=on. Pair with mass_diff_to_variable_mod=1 for open search.

mass_offsets.description: Slash-separated mass offsets for offset search; '0' = none

mass_offsets_detailed.description: Detailed mass offset list (workflow suite format e.g. `541.0611(aa=DK);203.0794(aa=N)`); overrides mass_offsets when set

labile_search_mode.description: Labile-mod search (glyco/labile PTM): 'nglycan' for N-glyco, 'labile' for O-glyco/labile PTMs, 'off' for standard. Pairs with mass_offsets.

labile_fragment_ion_series.description: Fragment ion series retained in labile search (e.g. 'b,y')

enzyme_name.description: search engine enzyme name (e.g. stricttrypsin, trypsin, chymotrypsin)

enzyme_nocut.description: Residues that block cleavage (e.g. 'P' for trypsin)

enzyme_sense.description: Cutting terminus of the first enzyme (C- or N-terminal)

enzyme_name_2.description: Second enzyme name; empty = single-enzyme digest

variable_mods.description: Extra variable mods beyond the oxidation/acetyl toggles, in workflow suite params format `<mass> <residues> <max>`, semicolon-separated. e.g. `79.966331 STY 3` (phospho), `114.04293 K 2` (GG/ubiquitin), `42.0106 K 2` (acetyl-K).

fixed_mods.description: Additional fixed modifications as search engine `add_*` entries, semicolon- or newline-separated `key = mass`. e.g. `add_S_serine = 79.96633; add_Nterm_protein = 42.0106`. Covers every residue/terminus beyond the C/K/N-term toggles.

allow_multiple_variable_mods_on_residue.description: Allow more than one variable mod on the same residue

tmt_label_mass.description: If set, add as fixed mod on K and peptide N-term (e.g. 229.16293 for TMT-6/10/11plex). None = LFQ.

tmt_kside_variable.description: When True, TMT is fixed only on the peptide N-term (not K). Use for acetyl/ubiquitin workflows where K carries a variable label — supply `229.16293 K 2` + the PTM via variable_mods.

activation_types.description: Only search scans of these activation types, '/'-separated (all, HCD, CID, ETD, ECD). ETD/EThcD workflows set this together with fragment_ion_series=c,z

analyzer_types.description: Only search scans from these analyzers, '/'-separated (all, FTMS, ITMS). mzML/raw only

fragment_ion_series.description: Ion series used in search: any of a,b,c,x,y,z,Y,b-18,y-18 (comma-separated). ETD/ECD data needs `c,z`; glyco labile searches add `Y`

ion_series_definitions.description: Custom ion series, e.g. `b* N -17.026548;b0 N -18.010565`

use_topN_peaks.description: Pre-process each spectrum down to its top N peaks

minimum_peaks.description: Minimum peaks in an experimental spectrum for matching

minimum_ratio.description: Drop peaks below this fraction of the base peak

clear_mz_range.description: Remove peaks in this m/z range before matching, `<lo> <hi>` (0.0 0.0 = off). Used to clear the TMT reporter region

deisotope.description: 0 = off, 1 = on (singletons single-charged), 2 = on (singletons single or double)

remove_precursor_peak.description: 0 = keep, 1 = remove precursor charge peak, 2 = remove all charge states (DDA only)

remove_precursor_range.description: m/z window (Th) used when removing precursor peaks

require_precursor.description: Discard PSMs without a precursor peak (DIA only)

reuse_dia_fragment_peaks.description: Allow one peak to match several peptides (DIA only)

precursor_charge.description: Assumed precursor charge range `<lo> <hi>`; only used when override_charge = 1

override_charge.description: Ignore the precursor charge in the file and use precursor_charge instead

max_fragment_charge.description: Maximum theoretical fragment charge to match

clip_nTerm_M.description: Treat protein N-terminal Met removal as a variable modification

Y_type_masses.description: [nglycan/labile only] Labile-mod fragments retained on intact peptides (glycan Y ions). Requires `Y` in fragment_ion_series

diagnostic_fragments.description: [nglycan/labile only] Diagnostic (oxonium) fragment masses. Requires diagnostic_intensity_filter > 0

diagnostic_intensity_filter.description: [nglycan/labile only] Minimum summed oxonium-ion intensity (relative to base peak) for a spectrum to count as diagnostic-positive

remainder_fragment_masses.description: [labile only] Partial modification masses left on b/y ions after fragmentation

restrict_deltamass_to.description: Residues that may carry a delta mass / mass offset (capitalized single letters, '-' for termini, or 'all')

min_matched_fragments.description: Minimum matched peaks for a PSM to be reported

min_sequence_matches.description: [nglycan/labile only] Minimum sequence-specific (non-Y) ions for a match

min_fragments_modelling.description: Minimum matched peaks for a PSM to enter statistical modelling

delta_mass_exclude_ranges.description: Fragment mass ranges excluded from delta-mass localization, e.g. `(-1.5,3.5)`. Empty = derived from localize_delta_mass

precursor_mass_mode.description: Which precursor mass search engine uses (workflow suite uses 'corrected')

group_variable.description: Group-FDR variable: 0 = no group FDR, 1 = num_enzyme_termini, 2 = PE from the protein header

use_all_mods_in_first_search.description: Use all variable modifications in the first search pass

track_zero_topN.description: Track top N unmodified hits separately (open-search boosting)

zero_bin_accept_expect.description: Rank a zero-bin hit first when its expect value is below this

zero_bin_mult_expect.description: Multiplier applied to zero-bin expect values (<1 boosts them)

decoy_prefix.description: Decoy sequence prefix (must match toolkit database)

output_report_topN.description: Report top N PSMs per spectrum

output_max_expect.description: Suppress a PSM whose top hit has an expect value above this

report_alternative_proteins.description: Report alternative proteins for shared peptides

write_calibrated_mzml.description: Write calibrated MS2 scans to mzML (downstream rescoring predictor/quantifier can consume them)

write_uncalibrated_mzml.description: Write uncalibrated MS2 scans to MGF (.raw/.d inputs only)

extra_params.description: Escape hatch: extra `key = value` lines appended to search.params (newline or ';' separated). Overrides a key we already write.

precursor_charge_min.description: Lower precursor charge bound for chimeric detection

isotope_number.description: Number of theoretical isotope peaks to consider

correct_isotope_error.description: Update precursor neutral mass with monoisotopic mass when isotope error detected

grppr_jar_path.description: Path to grppr jar (precursor refiner's required classpath sibling)

test_fdr.description: FDR threshold used to evaluate end results (--testFDR)

subset_max_train.description: Train on a subset of N PSMs (0 = use all). Recommended >0 for >1M PSMs.

post_processing_tdc.description: Use target-decoy competition instead of mix-max (--post-processing-tdc)

decoy_prefix.description: Decoy protein-id prefix; only used when picked_protein_fasta is set

picked_protein_fasta.description: If set, enable picked-protein FDR using this FASTA (--picked-protein). Leave empty for PSM/peptide-only output.

post_processing_mix_max.description: Explicitly use the mix-max method (--post-processing-mix-max); mutually exclusive with post_processing_tdc

quick_validation.description: Faster run with reduced internal cross-validation (--quick-validation)

train_fdr_initial.description: FDR threshold for the first SVM iteration (--train-fdr-initial)

train_best_positive.description: At most one PSM per spectrum may be a training positive (--train-best-positive)

default_direction.description: Feature used as the initial search direction (--default-direction), e.g. `hyperscore`

init_weights.description: Path to a weights file used to seed the SVM (--init-weights)

static_weights.description: Use init_weights as a fixed scoring vector, no training (--static). Requires init_weights

unit_norm.description: Unit [0-1] feature normalization instead of standard deviation (--unitnorm)

pep_algorithm.description: Posterior-error-probability estimator: default, cubic-spline (--irls-pep), isotonic PAVA (--pava-pep) or score-based (--ip-pep)

output_retention_time.description: Add a retention-time column to the outputs (--output-retention-time)

pepxml_output.description: Also write a rudimentary pepXML to this path (--pepxml-output)

protein_enzyme.description: Enzyme used for in-silico protein digestion in picked-protein mode (--protein-enzyme)

spectral_counting_fdr.description: Enable protein spectral counting at this FDR (--spectral-counting-fdr)

no_terminate.description: Keep going on recoverable input errors (--no-terminate)

extra_cmdline.description: Escape hatch: extra rescorer flags appended verbatim (e.g. `--search-input concatenated`)

jar_path.description: Path to workflow suite.jar (the shadow jar that contains rescorerOutputToPepXML)

data_type.description: Acquisition mode — DDA reads <basename>.pepXML, DIA reads <basename>_rank<N>.pepXML

min_prob.description: Minimum rescorer probability to emit (mirrors workflow suite's --min-prob)

updated_fasta_path.description: Optional FASTA path rewritten into the output pepXML's <search_database local_path=...> field. Empty leaves it as-is.

decoy_prefix.description: Decoy sequence prefix; must match search engine's decoy_prefix

add_contam.description: Append the common-contaminants set (cRAP-style) to the target FASTA

contam_prefix.description: Mark contaminant sequences with a prefix tag

enzyme.description: Enzyme for in-silico digestion (affects sequence classification only)

reviewed.description: Use only reviewed Swiss-Prot entries (ignored when --custom is the source)

add_sequences.description: Path to an extra UniProt-format FASTA whose sequences are appended (--add), e.g. spike-ins or a mutant panel

proteome_id.description: UniProt proteome ID to download instead of using a local FASTA (--id), e.g. `UP000005640`. Requires network access from the sandbox

decoy_prefix.description: Decoy sequence tag (--decoy); must match upstream search engine / database setting

output_prefix.description: Prefix for the interact-*.pep.xml output filename (--output)

decoyprobs.description: Compute probabilities for decoy hits too (--decoyprobs)

combine.description: Combine all input pepXMLs into one model (--combine)

min_prob.description: Report only PSMs above this probability (--minprob); unset = PSM validator default 0.05

min_pep_len.description: Minimum peptide length not rejected (--minpeplen); unset = 7

clevel.description: Conservative level in neg_stdev from neg_mean (--clevel); higher = more conservative

enzyme.description: Enzyme used in the sample (--enzyme); empty = inferred from the pepXML

ignore_charges.description: Comma-separated charge states excluded from modelling (--ignorechg), e.g. `1,5`

expectscore.description: Use the expectation value as the only f-value contributor (--expectscore)

mods.description: Modification sites + masses (site localizer positional arg). Format: `<residues>:<mass>` items joined by commas, e.g. `STY:79.966331,M:15.9949,n:42.0106` (n = peptide N-term).

minprob.description: Minimum PSM validator probability for a PSM to be evaluated (MINPROB=)

em.description: EM model: 0 none, 1 intensity, 2 intensity+matched-peaks (default), 3 matched-peaks

keepold.description: Retain prior site localizer results in the pepXML (KEEPOLD)

static.description: Use a single fragppmtol for all PSMs (STATIC) instead of per-PSM estimation

nions.description: Comma-separated N-term ion types (NIONS=); defaults to b for CID

nostack.description: Disallow stacking multiple PTMs at the same residue (NOSTACK)

maxthreads.description: Worker threads (MAXTHREADS=). Was pinned to 1 because the key wasn't declared — large datasets should raise this

cions.description: Comma-separated C-term ion types (CIONS=); empty = y for CID, z for ETD

ppmtol.description: MS1 precursor ppm tolerance (PPMTOL=); unset = 1 ppm

daltontol.description: MS2 fragment tolerance in Da (DALTONTOL=); overrides fragppmtol when set

maxfragz.description: Maximum fragment charge (MAXFRAGZ=); negative values subtract from the precursor charge

modprec.description: Decimal digits used when writing PTM masses (MODPREC=)

massoffset.description: Adjust the massdiff by this offset (MASSOFFSET=)

massdiffmode.description: Treat the measured−theoretical mass difference as the modification and localize it (MASSDIFFMODE)

exclude_massdiff_min.description: Lower bound of the mass-difference range excluded in MASSDIFFMODE (EXCLUDEMASSDIFFMIN=)

exclude_massdiff_max.description: Upper bound of the mass-difference range excluded in MASSDIFFMODE (EXCLUDEMASSDIFFMAX=)

lability.description: Compute PTM lability (LABILITY) — glyco / labile PTMs

direct.description: Use only direct evidence for site probabilities (DIRECT)

autodirect.description: Use direct evidence when lability is high (AUTODIRECT; pair with lability)

denoise.description: Remove presumed noise peaks before localization (DENOISE)

no_update.description: Don't rewrite modification_info tags in the pepXML (NOUPDATE)

extra_cmdline.description: Escape hatch: extra flags appended verbatim (e.g. OSCOREMODE, QUANTMODE, MINO=2). NOTE: site localizer is order-sensitive — flags that must precede the mods string (NOSTACK-style) have first-class params above; use this for the trailing long tail.

decoy_prefix.description: Decoy sequence tag (--tag); must match upstream search engine / database setting

inference.description: Run protein-level inference via protein inference (produces combined.prot.xml, passed to filter as --protxml; mirrors workflow suite). Disable for PSM/peptide-only reports — that also drops filter's --prot / --sequential / --razor, the way workflow suite does when no protXML exists.

inference_min_prob.description: Minimum peptide probability protein inference admits (--minprob); unset = toolkit's 0.05. 29 official workflows ask for 0.5.

inference_max_ppm_diff.description: protein inference's peptide mass window for protein grouping (--maxppmdiff). workflow suite's baseline 2000000 effectively disables it.

razor.description: Use razor-peptide algorithm for protein scoring

report_decoys.description: Include decoy hits in the report (--decoys)

report_msstats.description: Emit an MSstats-compatible CSV alongside the TSVs (--msstats)

remove_contam.description: Strip contaminants from the final report (--removecontam)

pep_prob.description: Top-peptide probability threshold used in FDR filtering (--pepProb); unset = 0.7

prot_prob.description: Protein probability threshold (--protProb, ignored with razor); unset = 0.5

min_pep_len.description: Minimum peptide length for protein probability assignment (--minPepLen); unset = 7

group_filter.description: Use the group label when filtering (--group)

map_mods.description: Map modifications onto the filtered results (--mapmods)

filter_mods.description: Modifications to stratify the FDR filter by (--mods), e.g. `M:15.9949,n:42.0106`. Empty = one pooled population, toolkit's default.

delta_mass_stratify.description: Stratify PSMs by delta-mass profile before FDR filtering (--delta); open / labile searches

report_ionmobility.description: Force the ion-mobility column into the reports (--ionmobility). timsTOF data

report_prefix.description: Prefix report filenames with the project/folder name (--prefix)

read_raw.description: Read vendor raw files instead of converted mzML/mzXML (--raw)

extra_cmdline.description: Escape hatch: extra `toolkit quant-lfq` argv appended verbatim (shell-quoted)

brand.description: Isobaric labeling brand (--brand): tmt, itraq or sCLIP. Required for a real run; toolkit declares no default

plex.description: Number of reporter-ion channels (--plex), e.g. 10/11/16. Required for a real run; toolkit declares no default

annotation_file.description: Annotation file mapping channels to sample names (--annot)

level.description: MS level the reporter ions are read from (--level)

minprob.description: Only use PSMs above this probability (--minprob)

removelow.description: Ignore the lower fraction of PSMs by summed abundance (--removelow); 0 = keep all

bestpsm.description: Keep only the best PSM per peptide for protein quantification (--bestpsm)

read_raw.description: Read vendor raw files instead of converted mzML/mzXML (--raw)

extra_cmdline.description: Escape hatch: extra `toolkit quant-reporter` argv appended verbatim (shell-quoted)

protein.description: Emit the global protein report combined_protein.tsv (--protein); needs combined.prot.xml from protein-infer

peptide.description: Emit the global peptide report combined_peptide.tsv (--peptide); needs combined.pep.xml from psm-integrate

decoy_prefix.description: Decoy sequence tag (--tag); must match the upstream filter/database setting

razor.description: Use razor peptides for protein FDR scoring (--razor); match the upstream report setting

picked.description: Apply the picked-FDR algorithm before protein scoring (--picked)

labels.description: The datasets carry isobaric labels — combine channel abundances too (--labels)

plex.description: Number of isobaric channels (--plex); only meaningful with labels=True

uniqueonly.description: Combine isobaric quantification from unique peptides only (--uniqueonly)

full.description: Generate combined tables with extra columns (--full)

reprint.description: Also write Reprint-format tables reprint.spc.tsv / reprint.int.tsv (--reprint)

extra_cmdline.description: Escape hatch: extra `toolkit aggregate-reports` argv appended verbatim (shell-quoted)

mztol_ppm.description: MS1 mass tolerance (ppm) for feature extraction

minisotopes.description: Minimum isotopes required in feature extraction

minscans.description: Minimum MS1 scans required in feature extraction

perform_ms1quant.description: Run MS1 quant (LFQ); turn off for TMT-only experiments

isolevel.description: MS level reporter ions are read from (2=MS2, 3=MS3). Only when perform_isoquant=True.

annotation_file.description: TMT channel→sample annotation file. Required for isoquant (passed as --annotation <psm.tsv>=<file>).

isotol_ppm.description: MS2 reporter-ion tolerance in ppm (--isotol); unset = quantifier default 10

site_reports.description: Generate PTM site reports (needs localization columns in psm.tsv)

ionmobility.description: Data carries ion mobility (--ionmobility). Required for timsTOF LC-MS

mbrrttol.description: MBR retention-time tolerance in minutes (--mbrrttol); unset = 1.0

mbrtoprun.description: Maximum donor runs per acceptor run (--mbrtoprun); unset = 10

minions.description: Minimum ions required to quantify a protein, MaxLFQ only (--minions); unset = 1

minexps.description: Minimum experiments an ion must appear in (--minexps); unset = 1

minfreq.description: Minimum frequency for an ion to be used in protein quant (--minfreq); unset = 0

topn_ions.description: Ions used per protein, 0 = all (--tp); unset = 0

uniqueness.description: Peptide→protein uniqueness (--uniqueness): 0 = unique+razor, 1 = unique only, 2 = all

intensitymode.description: Ion intensity mode (--intensitymode): 0 = apex, 1 = area, 2 = auto

writeindex.description: Write a reusable spectral index to disk (--writeindex)

label_formula.description: Chemical formulas of the labelling mods (--formula), e.g. `C(2)H(2)O;2H(4)C(2)`. Required for isotope-labelling quantification

requantify.description: Re-quantify ions the search did not identify (--requantify). Unset = quantifier's default, except with light/medium/heavy labels where it defaults to on

extra_cmdline.description: Escape hatch: extra quantifier flags appended verbatim (e.g. `--filelist /path/flags.txt`)

glyco_mode.description: Enable glycan-PTM analysis path (emitted as PTM profiler's `run_glyco_mode`)

n_glyco.description: N-glycan branch (vs O-glycan) when glyco_mode is on

histo_bindivs.description: Histogram bins per Dalton used in peakpicking

histo_smoothbins.description: Peakpicking smoothing factor (weight spread to N adjacent bins)

histo_normalizeTo.description: Normalize dataset size to PSM count or MS2 scan count

peakpicking_mass_units.description: Peakpicking mass units: 0 = Da, 1 = ppm. Pairs with `peakpicking_width`; workflow suite's open-search config uses 0 (0.002 Da) and its offset-search config uses 1 (3 ppm)

spectra_condRatio.description: Minimum peak intensity as a fraction of the base peak

localization_background.description: Localization enrichment background: 1=bin peptides, 2=bin PSMs, 3=all peptides, 4=all PSMs

localization_allowed_res.description: Residues allowed to carry the shift (e.g. `STY`, `N`); empty = no restriction

localize_delta_mass.description: search engine already localized delta-mass fragment ions (pair with the search node's localize_delta_mass)

use_msfragger_localization.description: Reuse search engine's localization columns instead of re-localizing. Requires a psm.tsv that still carries them (no rescorer / precursor refiner in between)

msfragger_massdiff_to_varmod.description: Re-synthesise variable mods from Delta Mass. Only for a psm.tsv whose `Modified Peptide` column is empty

annotate_assigned_mods.description: Annotate shifts using the PSM table's assigned modifications

annotation_file.description: `glyco`, `unimod`, `common`, or path to custom annotation table; empty = unimod

annotation_tol.description: Mass tolerance (Da) for matching shifts to known modifications

mass_offsets.description: Slash-separated list to restrict peakpicking to (e.g. `0/-105.0248/-89.0299`); empty = full open search

spectra_ppmtol.description: MS2 ppm tolerance for localization + spectral similarity

compare_betweenRuns.description: Allow spectral similarity / RT calculation across runs

prep_for_ionquant.description: Prepare PSM table for downstream quantifier

glycodatabase.description: Glycan database: comma-separated compositions (e.g. `HexNAc(2)Hex(3)`) or a path to a .glyc file; empty = PTM profiler default

glyco_ppm_tol.description: Precursor ppm tolerance for glycan mass matching

glyco_isotope_min.description: Minimum isotope error for glycan matching

glyco_isotope_max.description: Maximum isotope error for glycan matching

cap_y_ions.description: Y-ion (peptide + glycan remainder) masses searched in the spectrum

diag_ions_normalize.description: Normalize diagnostic ion intensities: 0 = off, 1 = base peak

glyco_cap_y_ions_normalize.description: Normalize Y-ion intensities: 0 = off, 1 = base peak

max_cap_y_charge.description: Maximum Y-ion charge state (0 = tool default)

remainder_masses.description: Comma-separated remainder masses localized onto the peptide

remainder_mass_allowed_res.description: Residues that may carry a remainder mass (`all` or a residue list)

remove_glycan_delta_mass.description: Strip the glycan delta mass from the reported peptide mass

put_glycans_to_assigned_mods.description: Write assigned glycans into the psm.tsv `Assigned Modifications` column (needed by downstream quantifier/isobaric quantifier)

print_full_glyco_params.description: Echo the full resolved glyco parameter set into the log

print_decoys.description: Include decoy glycan assignments in the reports

run_diagextract_mode.description: Extract intensities for the configured diagnostic ions

run_diagmine_mode.description: Mine unknown diagnostic ions / peptide remainders (Diagnostic-ion-mining workflow)

diagmine_minPeps.description: Minimum peptides per mass shift for diagnostic mining

diagmine_minIonsPerSpec.description: Minimum ions per spectrum for diagnostic mining

diagmine_diagMinFoldChange.description: Minimum fold change for a diagnostic ion to be reported

diagmine_diagMinSpecDiff.description: Minimum spectral percentage difference for a diagnostic ion

diagmine_fragMinFoldChange.description: Minimum fold change for a fragment remainder ion

diagmine_fragMinSpecDiff.description: Minimum spectral percentage difference for a fragment remainder ion

diagmine_fragMinPropensity.description: Minimum propensity for a fragment remainder ion

diagmine_pepMinFoldChange.description: Minimum fold change for a peptide remainder mass

diagmine_pepMinSpecDiff.description: Minimum spectral percentage difference for a peptide remainder mass

extra_params.description: Escape hatch: extra `key = value` lines appended to ptm-profile_config.txt (newline or ';' separated). Overrides a key we already write.

annotation_file.description: Path to TMT annotation file (whitespace-separated `<channel> <sample>` per line). Reference channels must use the value of `ref_tag` (default 'pool').

channel_num.description: Isobaric plex size — iTRAQ 4/8 or TMT 6/10/11/16/18/35 (label mass auto-derived: 4/8→iTRAQ 144.10, others→TMT/TMTpro)

ref_tag.description: Reference-channel tag (matched against sample column of annotation file)

add_Ref.description: Artificial reference: -2 raw, -1 disabled, 0 sum, 1 avg, 2 median

groupby.description: Aggregation level: -1 all, 0 gene, 1 protein, 2 peptide, 3 multi-site, 4 single-site, 5 multi-mass

prot_norm.description: Normalization: -1 all, 0 none, 1 MC, 2 GN, 3 SL+IRS

allow_overlabel.description: Accept PSMs with extra TMT on Ser

allow_unlabeled.description: Accept PSMs without any TMT tag

best_psm.description: Keep highest-intensity PSM per peptide per run

ms1_int.description: Use MS1 precursor intensity (else MS2 reference) for ref sample abundance

min_pep_prob.description: Minimum PSM probability (in addition to toolkit FDR)

min_percent.description: Drop PSMs whose summed-TMT intensity is in the lowest fraction

min_site_prob.description: Site-localization confidence (-1 global, 0 search engine, >0 site localizer)

unique_gene.description: Gene-uniqueness filter: 0 keep all, 1 drop multi-gene-evidence, 2 drop all multi-gene-in-fasta

mod_tag.description: PTM specification for site-specific reports (e.g. 'S(79.9663),T(79.9663),Y(79.9663)' for phospho)

prot_exclude.description: Protein accession prefixes to drop (e.g. 'sp|,tr|'). 'none' = keep all.

label_masses.description: Isobaric label mass. Empty = derived from channel_num (iTRAQ 144.10253, TMT 229.16293, TMTpro 304.20715)

max_pep_prob_thres.description: Peptide probability above which a PSM is always kept (0 = off)

glyco_qval.description: Glycan q-value filter for glyco-TMT reports (-1 = off)

use_glycan_composition.description: Index site reports by glycan composition instead of mass (N-glyco only)

print_RefInt.description: Print reference-channel intensities in the reports

combined_protein.description: Path to combined_protein.tsv used for gene/protein annotation of the reports

abn_type.description: Abundance type reported (0 = ratio-derived, 1 = intensity); unset = isobaric quantifier default

min_resolution.description: Minimum MS2 resolution required to resolve the reporter ions; unset = tool default

extra_params.description: Escape hatch: extra `key = value` entries merged into tmt-i_config.yml (newline or ';' separated). Overrides a key we already write.

library_path.description: Path to spectral library (.tsv/.speclib). DIA engine's --lib argument. Optional if upstream speclib-build supplies library*.tsv via inputs (hybrid topology).

fasta_path.description: Optional fasta for protein inference (--fasta). Empty disables protein-level reports.

matrix_spec_qvalue.description: Run-specific protein spec-q for matrix reporting (--matrix-spec-q); unset = DIA engine's default (no filter), which is what workflow suite runs with

skip_quant.description: DEPRECATED / no-op: DIA engine has no '--no-quant' option (it warns 'unrecognised option' and quantifies anyway). Kept so existing graphs still validate. Use `no_quant_files` or `quant_only` instead.

no_quant_files.description: Don't write intermediate .quant files to disk (--no-quant-files)

quant_only.description: Only run quantification using existing .quant files (--quant-only)

fasta_search.description: Library-free mode: digest the FASTA in silico (--fasta-search). Requires fasta_path (or a .fasta input); library_path becomes optional.

gen_spec_lib.description: Generate a spectral library from this run (--gen-spec-lib)

predictor.description: Deep-learning prediction of spectra/RT/IM for the in-silico library (--predictor)

out_lib.description: Output spectral library path (--out-lib); empty = <output_dir>/report-lib.tsv when gen_spec_lib is on

cut.description: In-silico digest rule (--cut), e.g. `K*,R*` for trypsin, `--cut` empty = DIA engine default

missed_cleavages.description: Maximum missed cleavages for the in-silico digest (--missed-cleavages)

var_mods.description: Extra variable mods, semicolon-separated `<name>,<mass>,<sites>` (each becomes a --var-mod argument), e.g. `UniMod:21,79.966331,STY`

mass_acc.description: MS2 mass accuracy in ppm (--mass-acc); unset = DIA engine auto-determines

mass_acc_ms1.description: MS1 mass accuracy in ppm (--mass-acc-ms1); unset = auto

report_lib_info.description: Add the library's own columns to report.tsv (--report-lib-info)

individual_mass_acc.description: Determine mass accuracy per run instead of once for the batch (--individual-mass-acc); workflow suite sets it for unrelated runs

individual_windows.description: Determine the scan window per run (--individual-windows); workflow suite sets it for unrelated runs

il_eq.description: Treat isoleucine and leucine as equal (--il-eq)

reannotate.description: Re-annotate the library against the FASTA (--reannotate)

extra_cmdline.description: Escape hatch: free-form extra args appended verbatim (e.g. `--no-cut-after-mod --individual-mass-acc`)

BoostComplementaryIon.description: Boost complementary ion pairs (helpful for library building)

WindowType.description: DIA isolation scheme. SWATH = fixed windows (uses WindowSize); V_SWATH = variable windows (needs a window list via extra_params `==window setting begin`); MSX / MSE / pSMART for those acquisitions

WindowSize.description: Isolation window width (Th) for WindowType = SWATH

NoMissedScan.description: Allowed missed scans within a peak curve (SE.NoMissedScan)

MaxCurveRTRange.description: Maximum peak-curve RT width in minutes (SE.MaxCurveRTRange)

RemoveGroupedPeaks.description: Remove fragment peaks already grouped to another precursor (SE.RemoveGroupedPeaks)

RemoveGroupedPeaksRTOverlap.description: RT overlap threshold for grouped-peak removal (SE.RemoveGroupedPeaksRTOverlap)

extra_params.description: Escape hatch: extra `key = value` lines appended to dia-pseudo_se.params (newline or ';' separated). Also how a V_SWATH variable-window table is supplied.

deltaApexIM.description: Ion-mobility Δ for MS1/MS2 apex match (--deltaApexIM)

deltaApexRT.description: Apex-scan Δ range for MS1/MS2 match (--deltaApexRT, integer scans)

bruker_lib_dir.description: Path to ext/bruker dir containing libtimsdata-*.so (JVM -Dlibs.bruker.dir)

max_delta_unimod.description: Maximum Δ mass (Da) for UniMod annotation

max_delta_ppm.description: Maximum Δ mass (ppm) for UniMod annotation

max_psm_pep.description: Maximum PSM posterior-error probability for inclusion. Unset = speclib-build's own default, which differs per subcommand (0.5 for `convert`, 1 for `convertpsm`) — workflow suite passes neither, so a single value here silently over-filtered the glyco-DIA libraries

rt_lowess_fraction.description: LOWESS smoothing fraction for RT calibration (0 = cross-validate)

im_lowess_fraction.description: LOWESS smoothing fraction for IM calibration

nofdr.description: Skip FDR reassessment (assume custom upstream FDR filtering)

diannpqp.description: Emit DIA engine2-compatible PQP library alongside the TSV

unimod_xml.description: UniMod XML used for modification annotation (--unimod); empty = spectral library builder's bundled copy

exclude_range.description: Mass-difference range NOT mapped to UniMod (--exclude-range), e.g. `-1.5,3.5`

enable_unannotated.description: Keep delta masses that have no UniMod match (--enable_unannotated)

enable_massdiff.description: Map mass differences reported by legacy search engines (--enable_massdiff)

precision_digits.description: Digits of product m/z precision in the library (--precision_digits); unset = 6

convert_from_psm.description: Build the library from psm.tsv via `speclib-build convertpsm` instead of pepXML via `speclib-build convert`

decoy_prefix.description: Database decoy prefix used to flag decoy PSMs (--decoy_prefix, convertpsm only)

labile_mods.description: Adjust fragment masses of labile (glyco) modifications — one of oglyc / nglyc / nglyc+ (--labile_mods, convertpsm only); empty = regular, non-glyco

max_glycan_q.description: Maximum glycan q-value for a PSM to enter the library (--max_glycan_q, convertpsm only)

rt_reference.description: iRT/CiRT reference file for RT alignment (--rt_reference)

rt_filter.description: Tag used to pick candidate RT reference runs (--rt_filter)

rt_psm_fdr_threshold.description: PSM FDR used for RT alignment (--rt_psm_fdr_threshold); unset = 0.001

im_reference.description: IM reference file for ion-mobility alignment (--im_reference)

im_filter.description: Tag used to pick candidate IM reference runs (--im_filter)

im_psm_fdr_threshold.description: PSM FDR used for IM alignment (--im_psm_fdr_threshold); unset = 0.001

min_peptides.description: Minimum peptides required for a successful alignment (--min_peptides); unset = 5

pi0_lambda.description: Non-parametric p-value estimation `<START> <END> <STEPS>` (--pi0_lambda), e.g. `0.1 0.5 0.05`, or `0.4 0 0` for a fixed value

consensus.description: Build consensus spectra instead of picking the best replicate

extra_convert_cmdline.description: Escape hatch: extra flags for each `speclib-build convert` call

extra_library_cmdline.description: Escape hatch: extra flags for the `speclib-build library` call

glyco_db.description: O-glycan composition list (comma-separated, workflow suite Byonic syntax) — CMD -g

filter_oxonium.description: Enable oxonium-ion based glycan filtering — CMD -f

oxonium_filter_file.description: Custom oxonium rules file path (empty = use CMD's default list)

oxonium_min_intensity.description: Minimum relative oxonium intensity for filtering (0-1) — CMD -m

glycan_residues_file.description: Glycan residue definitions (workflow suite Glycan_Databases) — CMD -x

glycan_mods_file.description: Glycan modification definitions (workflow suite Glycan_Databases) — CMD -y

activation1.description: Primary scan activation for PairScans (glycan/oxonium scan)

activation2.description: Paired scan activation for PairScans (peptide-backbone scan)

verbosity.description: How much CMD writes to the log — CMD -v

extra_cmdline.description: Escape hatch: extra glyco localizer CMD flags appended verbatim

diann_path.description: Path to local DIA engine binary

unimod_obo.description: Path to unimod.obo for modification lookup

batmass_io_jar.description: Path to spectrum IO jar (required for mzML reading)

use_koina.description: Use a remote Koina server for predictions instead of the local DIA engine (useKoina). Requires koina_url and network access from the sandbox

koina_url.description: Koina server URL (KoinaURL); only used when use_koina is on

find_best_rt_model.description: Benchmark the available RT models and keep the best (findBestRtModel)

find_best_spectra_model.description: Benchmark the available spectra models and keep the best (findBestSpectraModel)

find_best_im_model.description: Benchmark the available IM models and keep the best (findBestImModel)

fragmentation_type.description: Fragmentation type passed to the predictor (FragmentationType): auto, HCD, CID, ETD, ETHCD, …

instrument.description: Instrument type hint for the predictor (instrument), e.g. `QE`, `LUMOS`, `TIMSTOF`

ppm_tolerance.description: Fragment matching tolerance in ppm (ppmTolerance); unset = rescoring predictor default 20

features.description: Explicit feature list written into the pin (features), comma-separated. Empty = rescoring predictor's default feature set

delete_predictions.description: Delete prediction files after the run (deletePreds)

extra_params.description: Escape hatch: extra `key = value` lines appended to predict-rescore_params.txt (newline or ';' separated). Covers the remaining ~100 rescoring predictor keys

min_prob.description: Minimum probability of results to report (--minProb)

sharpnse.description: Use more discriminating NSE model for SWATH (--sharpnse)

max_ppm_diff.description: Max peptide mass difference (ppm) for protein grouping (--maxppmdiff). workflow suite baseline uses 2000000 (effectively disabled — group only on sequence).

output_prefix.description: Output filename prefix (--output); produces <prefix>.prot.xml. workflow suite baseline uses 'combined'.

iprophet.description: Tell protein-infer input is from PSM integrator (--psm-integrate)

subgroups.description: Enable subgroups (--subgroups; baseline omits → no groups)
